race.description: Robbie Agnew Racing Country Boosted Mdn Hcp
race.comment: UNIVERSAL ENERGY (2) ran very well at his debut. He landed right with the speed and held on gamely. Has an important jockey change but not the best of barriers so will need a degree of fortune early. BILLYBAGO (9) was being beaten a margin but then boxed on at Wauchope. Would prefer it if the surface was on the softer side. DE RIGUER (11) has to be a big watch from this yard. She trialled up nicely and they have put a lugging bit straight on for guidance. Takes on older horses so must be going well. STORMY MARTINI (13) filly by D'argento on debut. Purchased for AUD $ 8,000 (Inglis 2025 HTBA Yearling Sale). Fitter for a recent trial placing. Watch the betting.
